metrics.name: Oracle 5Y CDS
metrics.frequency: Daily when licensed; weekly manual/proxy otherwise
metrics.primary_source: Bloomberg CDS <ORCL 5Y>, Markit/CDX, ICE CDS
metrics.public_proxy: Manual CDS file, ORCL bond OAS, or ORCL spread over BBB IG from FINRA/TRACE provider export
metrics.notes: Replace with licensed 5Y CDS or broker quote
metrics.meaning: Oracle未来五年信用违约保护的市场价格，可理解为市场为Oracle违约风险要求的保险费。
metrics.implication: 利差持续走阔，通常表示市场认为Oracle的违约或再融资风险上升，也意味着依赖债务支持的AI资本开支更容易受到约束。

metrics.name: Hyperscaler Bond OAS
metrics.frequency: Daily if using ICE/Bloomberg; weekly via manual export
metrics.primary_source: ICE/BofA bond OAS, Bloomberg BVAL/OAS, TRACE-derived curves
metrics.public_proxy: Manual CSV from broker/TRACE export; broad IG and BBB FRED OAS until issuer-level data is available
metrics.notes: Average of issuer_oas.csv
metrics.meaning: MSFT、AMZN、GOOGL、META和ORCL可比期限债券相对无风险利率的期权调整利差均值。
metrics.implication: 利差走阔说明投资者对大型AI资本开支主体要求更高补偿；若脱离整体IG市场单独上升，AI相关信用风险正在被独立定价。

metrics.name: Oracle Spread vs BBB IG
metrics.primary_source: Oracle OAS less ICE/BofA BBB OAS
metrics.public_proxy: Manual Oracle OAS less FRED BAMLC0A4CBBB
metrics.notes: ORCL OAS less BBB OAS
metrics.meaning: Oracle债券OAS减去美国BBB级公司债OAS，用来剔除整体投资级信用市场的共同波动。
metrics.implication: 数值转正并持续扩大，说明Oracle相对同评级企业被额外要求风险补偿，更接近Oracle及其AI投资链的特异性压力。

metrics.name: AI Bond Basket vs IG
metrics.primary_source: Custom AI issuer basket OAS less ICE/BofA US Corporate OAS
metrics.public_proxy: Manual AI basket OAS less FRED BAMLC0A0CM
metrics.notes: AI basket OAS less broad IG OAS
metrics.meaning: 固定AI相关发行人债券篮子的OAS减去广义美国投资级公司债OAS。
metrics.implication: 数值上升表示AI信用相对一般企业信用表现更弱；若同时伴随新债需求下降，可能是行业融资条件收紧的早期信号。

metrics.name: US BBB Corporate OAS
metrics.primary_source: FRED ICE BofA BBB US Corporate Index OAS
metrics.public_proxy: FRED series BAMLC0A4CBBB
metrics.notes: Broad refinancing backdrop for lower-rated investment-grade issuers.
metrics.meaning: 美国BBB级公司债相对美国国债的期权调整利差，是较低评级投资级企业的整体融资风险温度计。
metrics.implication: 利差走阔代表广泛的再融资环境恶化，会提高Oracle等BBB附近发行人的融资成本；单独看它不能区分AI风险和全市场风险。

metrics.name: US High Yield OAS
metrics.primary_source: FRED ICE BofA US High Yield Index OAS
metrics.public_proxy: FRED series BAMLH0A0HYM2
metrics.notes: Private credit and leveraged data-center financing typically reprice with HY stress.
metrics.meaning: 美国高收益债相对美国国债的期权调整利差，反映低评级和高杠杆借款人的市场风险补偿。
metrics.implication: 利差明显上升时，私募信贷、数据中心贷款和neocloud融资通常也会重新定价，融资可得性可能先于公开违约率恶化。

metrics.name: Hyperscaler New-Issue Volume, 4W
metrics.primary_source: Bloomberg DCM, Dealogic, IFR, company 8-Ks/prospectuses
metrics.public_proxy: Manual CSV from press releases, SEC filings, and broker calendars
metrics.notes: Trailing 4-week hyperscaler issuance
metrics.meaning: 大型云厂商及相关AI资本开支主体过去四周的新债发行总额。
metrics.implication: 发行量高并不必然危险；但若同时出现认购倍数下降或新发溢价上升，说明供给拥挤、市场吸收能力受到考验。

metrics.name: New-Issue Orderbook Cover
metrics.primary_source: Bloomberg/IFR deal books, syndicate desks
metrics.public_proxy: Manual CSV from deal reports; leave blank when unavailable
metrics.notes: Trailing 4-week average
metrics.meaning: 新债订单总额除以实际发行额，衡量一级市场投资者需求能覆盖发行规模多少倍。
metrics.implication: 认购倍数快速下降、尤其跌破约2倍，表示边际买盘转弱；发行人可能需要缩量、提高利差或推迟融资。

metrics.name: New-Issue Concession
metrics.primary_source: Bloomberg/IFR, TRACE secondary curves
metrics.public_proxy: Manual CSV; compare coupon/spread guidance with nearby outstanding bonds
metrics.notes: Trailing 4-week average
metrics.meaning: 新发行债券相对同发行人可比存量债券需要额外支付的利差。
metrics.implication: 溢价越高，说明市场需要更大的价格让步才能消化新供给，是一级融资渠道收紧和投资者议价权上升的直接信号。

metrics.name: Capex / FCF
metrics.primary_source: SEC XBRL companyfacts, 10-Q/10-K cash-flow statements
metrics.public_proxy: SEC API aggregate for hyperscalers
metrics.notes: Previous successful SEC snapshot retained
metrics.meaning: 大型云厂商资本开支除以自由现金流的中位数，衡量AI基础设施投入对内部现金创造的占用程度。
metrics.implication: 高于1倍意味着资本开支超过当期自由现金流，企业需要动用现金储备或外部融资；持续上升会降低资产负债表缓冲。

metrics.name: Debt / Capex
metrics.primary_source: SEC XBRL companyfacts
metrics.public_proxy: SEC API aggregate for hyperscalers
metrics.notes: Previous successful SEC snapshot retained
metrics.meaning: 资产负债表债务规模除以资本开支，用来观察当前投资强度背后累积了多少债务。
metrics.implication: 比率上升说明资本开支周期越来越受债务支持，在AI需求不及预期或资产利用率下降时，信用指标会更敏感。

metrics.name: Net Debt / EBITDA
metrics.primary_source: SEC XBRL companyfacts
metrics.public_proxy: SEC API aggregate; cash and debt tags plus operating income and D&A
metrics.notes: Previous successful SEC snapshot retained
metrics.meaning: 净债务除以EBITDA，是衡量企业杠杆和以经营收益偿还净债务能力的常用指标。
metrics.implication: 比率上升表示偿债缓冲减少、对再融资和盈利下滑更敏感；现金净额较大的企业可能为负值，需结合发行人分别观察。

metrics.name: Interest Coverage
metrics.primary_source: SEC XBRL companyfacts
metrics.public_proxy: Operating income divided by interest expense from SEC tags
metrics.notes: Previous successful SEC snapshot retained
metrics.meaning: 经营利润除以利息支出，表示经营利润可以覆盖年度利息成本多少倍。
metrics.implication: 倍数下降意味着付息安全垫变薄；对现金充裕的hyperscaler通常压力较低，但Oracle和高杠杆neocloud的恶化更具预警价值。

metrics.name: Purchase + Lease Obligations / Revenue
metrics.primary_source: 10-Q/10-K commitments footnotes, leases, cloud purchase commitments
metrics.public_proxy: Manual CSV using disclosed purchase commitments and operating lease obligations
metrics.notes: Median issuer disclosed commitments plus leases over revenue
metrics.meaning: 已披露采购承诺与租赁义务之和占收入的比例，反映尚未完全进入当期债务数据的长期固定支出。
metrics.implication: 比例上升说明未来固定付款义务增长快于收入；若AI终端需求不及预期，现金流可能受到合约承诺的刚性挤压。

metrics.name: Private Credit / BDC Stress Proxy
metrics.primary_source: BDC NAV discounts, PIK income ratios, non-accruals, interval fund redemptions
metrics.public_proxy: Manual CSV; BIZD/BDC ETF drawdowns and HY OAS as market proxy
metrics.notes: Replace with BDC NAV discount/PIK/non-accrual and private credit terms
metrics.meaning: 综合BDC净值折价、PIK收入占比、非应计贷款和赎回等信息形成的0-100私募信贷压力代理。
metrics.implication: 分数上升表示私募贷款资产质量、流动性或资金募集承压，数据中心和高杠杆AI借款人的融资条款可能随之收紧。

metrics.name: Data Center / Neocloud Financing Spread
metrics.primary_source: Private credit term sheets, ABS/data-center loan pricing, company financing announcements
metrics.public_proxy: Manual CSV; HY OAS plus listed neocloud equity stress as rough backup
metrics.notes: Replace with BDC NAV discount/PIK/non-accrual and private credit terms
metrics.meaning: 数据中心及neocloud借款相对基准利率支付的融资利差，来自贷款、ABS、私募信贷条款或公告。
metrics.implication: 利差走阔反映贷款人对抵押物价值、客户集中、算力需求或再融资能力更谨慎，可能直接拖慢AI基础设施建设链条。

index.name: AI Credit Stress Index
